changes.summary: Declared explicit resource limits and rootless capabilities in the portable recipe build contract.
changes.details: The recipe now carries every author-selectable Podman build input through the signed Controller-to-agent request, including a bounded capability list that defaults to empty. The agent drops all capabilities before adding only declared allowlisted entries inside Podman's rootless user namespace; host privilege, devices, mounts, sockets, security options, storage, cgroups, and generated image identity remain fixed platform policy.

changes.summary: Removed unnecessary public network access from the deterministic dual-Spark image build.
changes.details: The Dockerfile performs only local patching and verification after the digest-pinned base image is transferred separately.
The recipe now publishes an explicit abliterated alignment facet; consumers must not infer alignment from names or tags.

changes.summary: Adopted Drowzeys' upstream-published digest-pinned B12X runtime image.
changes.details: The adapter now builds directly from the validated linux/arm64 GHCR image instead of reinstalling b12x and Cutlass DSL from PyPI on every Spark; the reviewed overlays and non-root offline runtime remain unchanged.

changes.summary: Applied upstream's 0.85 unified-memory hard cap for the 1M profile.
changes.details: The previous 0.87 value is no longer recommended; operators should reduce concurrency or batched-token limits instead of raising the cap. Gated checkpoint inventory and physical two-Spark acceptance remain blocked separately.

changes.summary: Removed the synthetic snapshot digest and failed closed on gated Git files.
changes.details: The withdrawn model entity now lists 126 files with upstream-verifiable SHA-256 values. Thirteen Git files totaling 50,928 bytes return HTTP 401 without an accepted token and are explicitly excluded until an authenticated refresh; runtime and installed snapshot pins are unchanged.

changes.summary: Added Drowzeys' gated GLM 5.3 Flash NVFP4 KV 1M two-Spark Candidate.
changes.details: Pins the exact serving source and gated checkpoint revisions, packages the B12X NVFP4 KV and sparse-MLA overlays, and preserves the published 1,048,576 context, 7168 block, 6,334,808,064-byte KV allocation, MTP2, and native-mp TP2 profile.
